items.title: Gucci's New Campaign Gets It: Asian Stars Rule Fashion Now
items.summary: Philippine fashion outlet MEGA covers Gucci's newly launched Primavera campaign, highlighting that five of ten global talents cast are Asian (Jin, Ningning, Xiao Zhan, Lee Young Ae, Tarzzan), framing this as evidence Asian stars now carry major commercial weight for luxury houses. SEA-published commentary, though the cast itself skews East Asian rather than Southeast Asian.

items.title: Demna Calls on Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Ningning, Shawn Mendes and More for Gucci Primavera Campaign
items.summary: WWD trade report on the Primavera campaign, Demna's first ad communication of his debut Gucci collection, directed by Johan Renck with Kate Moss lip-syncing to Chris Isaak's Wicked Game; cast pulls heavily from music/film/sport including several Asian stars with large SEA fan followings.

items.title: Well-known shop owners prosecuted as fake Gucci, Hermes goods exposed
items.summary: Vietnamese authorities prosecuted multiple shop and workshop owners across Hanoi, Can Tho and HCMC for manufacturing and selling counterfeit Gucci, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Dior and Burberry goods sold via Zalo, TikTok, Facebook and Shopee; one Can Tho case alone involved goods valued over VND1.9 billion. Critical-angle item signalling scale of counterfeit-market pressure on brand exclusivity perception in Vietnam.

items.title: BTS Member Gets Brutally Trolled Over New Look (Jin's Gucci Primavera styling)
items.summary: Fan-community aggregation of harsh social-media backlash toward BTS member Jin's edgy eyeliner-heavy styling in the Gucci Primavera campaign photos; sampled comments call the look boring and criticize the makeup choice. Genuine unfiltered fandom sentiment (not brand PR) with a heavy SEA fan-base footprint (BTS ARMY is large across Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand); one fragment quoted under 15 words: "never seen a more boring kpop idol than him."

items.title: 260825 Ningning for GUCCI Primavera Campaign (Preview)
items.summary: Aespa fan-community site posts and discusses preview images of member Ningning's individual portrait in the Gucci Primavera campaign, part of organic fandom amplification/tracking of the brand's Asian-ambassador roster. Reflects real SEA-adjacent K-pop fandom engagement volume rather than brand-issued content.

items.title: New style vocabulary -- Gucci FW26 Primavera preview in Manila
items.summary: Coverage of a July 31 Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera preview at Greenbelt 4, Manila, with seven Filipino celebrities (Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Michelle Dee among them) styled in the collection, emphasizing fluid tailoring and the updated Bamboo 1947 bag. Slightly beyond the 7-day freshness target but within the 14-day cutoff; genuine SEA activation story.
